summary.text: Ted Alexander is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 44 since January 2019 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ted Alexander assumed office in the North Carolina State Senate on January 1, 2019, succeeding Vickie Sawyer.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations on General Government and Information Technology, State and Local Government, and Pensions and Retirement and Aging committees and as a member of the Appropriations/Base Budget, Commerce and Insurance and Finance committees.
